scope: Small conditional TRAIN-only representation/memory comparison, not production replacement or deployment qualification
observability: Command-free and unsaturated128ms measured windows; modes from first64ms forecast next64ms with centered explained energy >=0.5. No simulator poles, design identity, velocity, margin or future waveform in model inputs.
input: 174 analytical features from the complete accepted128ms window, availability flag and age since last accepted observation. Same inputs for framewise and GRU. Time-only GRU receives elapsed time alone.

training.loss: All-frame mean squared error, equal-size trajectories

randomization: Seed20261009 per design/replicate/profile; independently random initial ratio, ramp timing, stable and retreat velocity knots, pulse onset timing and amplitudes. Noise seed20261010. All copies remain within one design partition.
frozen: Original O1 models, partitions, thresholds and reserved dataset populations unchanged. New framewise/GRU models are explicitly trained on changed-aperture inputs. No calibrated warning policy claimed.
report: All-frame and observed-frame MAE; conditional optimistic errors near flutter; time-only control; missing observations and age; design/profile/noise breakdown. Output during gaps is model extrapolation, not measured availability or certified safe state.
